name: MORN Travel Platform
description: Direct booking platform for certified mountain expeditions, trekking tours, and helicopter transfers in Almaty, Kazakhstan with 0% agency markup.

resources.name: About MORN
resources.description: Platform mission, 0% markup guarantee, direct guide communication, and regional destination overview.

resources.name: Tours and Expeditions
resources.description: Complete catalog of 16 mountain tours, routes, elevations, durations, difficulties, and exact direct prices in KZT and USD.

resources.name: Certified Mountain Guides
resources.description: Registry of 11 verified guides across Powder Nomads, Monte Club, and Chobota with KMGA, KTA, WFTGA, and USAID credentials.

resources.name: Helicopter Fleet & Transfers
resources.description: Aircraft specifications (Eurocopter EC130 B4, Bell 505), Boraldai flight corridors, and hourly charter tariffs.

resources.name: Complete Pricing Guide
resources.description: Exhaustive price matrix, group-scale discounts, comfort upgrades, and co-sharing cost-splitting models.

resources.name: Platform FAQ
resources.description: Answers regarding 0% markup policy, payment options, refund terms, packing lists, and safety standards.

resources.name: LLMs Navigation Index
resources.description: Root AI crawler navigation index adhering to the standard llmstxt.org specification.

resources.name: LLMs Full Knowledge Base
resources.description: Complete single-document knowledge bundle for AI agents and LLMs with long context windows.

actions.name: book_tour
actions.description: Submits a direct booking application for a selected mountain tour or expedition with 0% markup. The guide contacts the client within 24 hours.

client_name.description: Full name of the primary traveler.

contact_info.description: Contact phone number (with country code) or Telegram/WhatsApp handle (e.g. +77011234567 or @traveler).

guests_count.description: Total number of participants in the group.

tour_slug.description: Unique identifier of the selected tour (e.g. tour1-essential, sovet-peak-4317m, kolsai-helicopter-3h-ec130).

data_share_consent.description: Consent to personal data processing for tour booking coordination.

actions.name: order_transfer
actions.description: Submits an order for a private vehicle transfer (4x4 SUV, Minivan, Executive Crossover).

destination.description: Destination name or coordinates (e.g. Kolsai Lakes, Saty, Medeu).

pickup_location.description: Pickup hotel name or address in Almaty.
